title: Deer holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGlow' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d81b4a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 28 Q58 40 56 52 Q55 56 54 60' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='19' rx='11' ry='13' fill='url(#balloonGlow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='15' rx='3.2' ry='4.2' fill='#ffd0da' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M60.5 31.5 L62 35 L63.5 31.5 Z' fill='#c4133d'/>
  <!-- deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='80' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#a86e36'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a86e36'/>
  <rect x='50' y='82' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#a86e36'/>
  <rect x='57' y='80' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#a86e36'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M48 66 L54 52 L62 54 L58 68 Z' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M58 60 Q64 54 56 52' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='48' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(-20 50 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='39' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(20 67 39)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#f2c9a0' transform='rotate(-20 50 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='39' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#f2c9a0' transform='rotate(20 67 39)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M51 40 Q48 30 44 26 M48 33 Q44 31 42 34' stroke='#f2e0b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 40 Q69 30 73 26 M69 33 Q73 31 75 34' stroke='#f2e0b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='52' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#f2c9a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='66.5' cy='50.5' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#6b3f1d'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='45' r='2' fill='#3a2412'/>
  <circle cx='57.7' cy='44.3' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='51' r='2' fill='#f19aa0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='70' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#f2e0b8'/>
</svg>
